newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland offers extra PLN 500 mln 52-week T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Poland offers extra PLN 500 mln 52-week T-bills.

text.p: Poland is offering 500 million zlotys worth of 52-week T-bills at an extra tender on April 10, the finance ministry said.
The value date will be Monday, April 14.
The treasury said it would still go ahead with its planned 1.1 billion zloty primary auction on Monday, April 14.
At today's tender demand totalled 1.74 billion zlotys against the ministry's 1.1 billion zloty offer, with most bids going for the benchmark 52-week paper.
